description: This file defines the DynamicField class, which manages custom dynamic fields within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving custom fields, as well as managing cache, schema modifications, and related metadata.

classes.name: DynamicField
classes.description: Represents a dynamic custom field manager for SuiteCRM, allowing creation, modification, deletion, and caching of custom fields, along with schema updates and metadata management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DynamicField object, setting module name, base path, and database connection.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the associated module.

methods.name: getPackageName
methods.description: Provides the package name counterpart; currently returns nothing.

methods.name: deleteCache
methods.description: Static method placeholder for cache deletion logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Associates a SugarBean object with the dynamic field and builds the cache if necessary.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the module in a specified language.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds the cache of custom fields for a module by querying the database.

methods.name: getFieldWidget
methods.description: Retrieves the widget object for a specific custom field.

methods.name: saveToVardef
methods.description: Saves custom field definitions into the global vardefs and triggers cache update.

methods.name: getJOIN
methods.description: Returns the necessary SQL SELECT and JOIN parts for retrieving custom fields in queries.

methods.name: getRelateJoin
methods.description: Generates SQL join info for relate type custom fields.

methods.name: fill_relationships
methods.description: Fills related module data for relate type custom fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists custom field data into the database, updating both main and custom tables.

methods.name: deleteField
methods.description: Deletes a custom field from the metadata and database schema.

methods.name: fieldExists
methods.description: Checks if a custom field already exists based on name and type.

methods.name: addFieldObject
methods.description: Adds a new custom field object to the system and updates schema and cache.

methods.name: saveExtendedAttributes
methods.description: Saves extended attributes for custom fields, such as additional properties.

methods.name: isDefaultValue
methods.description: Checks if a property's current value matches its default.

methods.name: writeVardefExtension
methods.description: Writes overridden vardef PHP files for a custom field.

methods.name: removeVardefExtension
methods.description: Removes the PHP override file for a custom field.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Creates and adds a new custom field using parameters.

methods.name: createCustomTable
methods.description: Creates the custom field table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: add_existing_custom_fields
methods.description: Ensures existing custom fields are added to the schema and cache.

methods.name: add_existing_custom_field
methods.description: Adds a specific custom field to the database schema.

methods.name: repairCustomFields
methods.description: Recreates or repairs the custom fields table, adding missing columns.

methods.name: addLabel
methods.description: Adds a label string to module language files.

methods.name: getDBName
methods.description: Generates a database-safe name string, optionally appending '_c'.

methods.name: setWhereClauses
methods.description: Sets SQL where clauses based on request parameters for custom fields.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves custom field data from database into bean properties.

methods.name: populateXTPL
methods.description: Populates an XTemplate object with custom field data for a specific view.

methods.name: populateAllXTPL
methods.description: Populates an XTemplate with all custom field data.

methods.name: getAllFieldsView
methods.description: Returns view-specific representations (xtpl/html) of all custom fields.
